intro.sr: Za velike ili teške artikle sistem ne može automatski da izračuna cenu dostave. Klijent odmah dobija samo informativni email da porudžbina čeka procenu - pravi email sa cenom i linkom za potvrdu stiže tek kad administrator unese stvarnu cenu dostave. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: For large or heavy items the system can't calculate shipping automatically. The customer immediately gets only an informational email that the order is pending a quote - the real email with the price and a confirm link only arrives once an admin enters the actual shipping cost. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
